Title: TC_001: Verify First Month Free Offer is communicated during new user onboarding
Steps:
1. Install app version released after this feature
2. Register as new user
3. Complete onboarding flow
4. Observe offer messaging and terms presentation
Expected Result: First Month Free Offer and associated terms are clearly communicated during onboarding per FSD UX section
Preconditions: New registered user without any pack/subscription; first app launch after feature release

Title: TC_002: Verify eligible new registered user without subscription sees promotional offer
Steps:
1. Log in as new registered user with no subscriptions
2. Navigate to sampling-enabled content
3. Observe promotional/sampling UI
Expected Result: Promotional offer and sampling banner are visible to eligible user
Preconditions: New registered user; no pack or channel subscription taken post registration

Title: TC_003: Verify existing user with any subscription does not see promo banner
Steps:
1. Log in as user with existing subscription
2. Navigate to content that would be sampling-enabled for eligible users
3. Observe banners
Expected Result: Promo/sampling banner is NOT displayed; user is not eligible per FSD
Preconditions: User registered and has taken any pack/subscription post registration

Title: TC_004: Verify user who subscribed after registration is not eligible for promo banner
Steps:
1. Log in as user who subscribed after registration
2. Open sampling-enabled content
3. Verify banner visibility
Expected Result: Promotional sampling banner is not shown
Preconditions: User took subscription after initial registration

Title: TC_005: Verify sampling banner displays remaining days and expiry month during free content consumption
Steps:
1. Log in as eligible user
2. Play/view sampling-enabled free content
3. Observe sampling banner text
Expected Result: Banner displays: Only xx days left to watch for free – till xx Month with correct values from backend
Preconditions: Eligible user with active free offer; viewing sampling-enabled content

Title: TC_006: Verify sampling banner appears below the player during playback
Steps:
1. Start playback of sampling-enabled content
2. Observe area below player
Expected Result: Sampling banner is displayed below the player
Preconditions: Eligible user playing sampling-enabled content

Title: TC_007: Verify sampling banner appears in content lists for relevant items
Steps:
1. Navigate to content list containing sampling-enabled items
2. Locate relevant list items
3. Observe banner on list items
Expected Result: Sampling banner is displayed in content lists for applicable items
Preconditions: Eligible user browsing content lists with sampling-enabled items

Title: TC_008: Verify Add Pack CTA is visible on sampling banner
Steps:
1. View sampling banner on player or list
2. Observe CTA on banner
Expected Result: Add Pack CTA is visible and clearly labeled on the sampling banner
Preconditions: Eligible user; promotional subscription not yet availed

Title: TC_009: Verify Add Pack CTA is generic until user avails promotion on PI page
Steps:
1. View sampling banner before availing offer on PI
2. Note CTA label and behaviour
3. Tap Add Pack
Expected Result: CTA displays generic Add Pack label and navigates to appropriate pack/subscription flow
Preconditions: Eligible user has not availed promotion on PI page

Title: TC_010: Verify Add Pack CTA is hidden after promotion offer availed on PI page
Steps:
1. Avail promotion offer on PI page
2. Return to sampling-enabled content
3. Observe banner CTA
Expected Result: Add Pack CTA is no longer displayed after entitlement changes in real time
Preconditions: User avails promotional subscription on PI page; entitlement updates in real time

Title: TC_011: Verify sampling banner not shown when promotion subscription availed
Steps:
1. Log in as user who availed promotion subscription
2. Open sampling-enabled content
3. Observe banner area
Expected Result: Sampling banner is NOT displayed for sampling-enabled content when promotion is availed
Preconditions: User has availed promotional subscription

Title: TC_012: Verify sampling banner shown when promotion subscription not availed
Steps:
1. Log in as eligible user without availed promotion
2. Open sampling-enabled content
3. Observe banner
Expected Result: Sampling banner IS displayed for sampling-enabled content
Preconditions: Eligible user; promotion not availed

Title: TC_013: Verify sampling banner disappears when offer no longer applicable
Steps:
1. Use account where offer is no longer applicable
2. Open previously sampling-enabled content
3. Observe banner
Expected Result: Sampling banner is not displayed when offer is no longer applicable
Preconditions: User offer period has ended or eligibility revoked

Title: TC_014: Verify expiry notification banner before offer ends
Steps:
1. Log in as user with offer nearing expiry
2. View free content
3. Read banner messaging
Expected Result: Banner shows Only xx days left to watch for free – till xx Month as expiry notification
Preconditions: Eligible user nearing offer end date

Title: TC_015: Verify remaining days on banner update in real time
Steps:
1. Note remaining days on banner
2. Wait for day rollover or trigger refresh
3. Re-observe banner
Expected Result: Remaining days count updates accurately in real time per PubNub/backend data
Preconditions: Eligible user with active offer; cross midnight boundary or backend refresh

Title: TC_016: Verify unsubscribed channel banner when user not subscribed to channel
Steps:

2. Observe banner above CTA
Expected Result: Banner displays: You have not subscribed to this Channel above the CTA
Preconditions: User not subscribed to channel being viewed; sampling may apply

Preconditions: User not subscribed; content is sampling-enabled

1. View unsubscribed channel content
2. Note banner text
3. Without subscribing navigate to another unsubscribed channel
Expected Result: Banner text remains generic You have not subscribed to this Channel until user adds that particular channel
Preconditions: User has not added/subscribed to specific channel
